acceptance_criteria.title: Valid percentage code.
acceptance_criteria.text: Applying SAVE10 to a ₹1000 subtotal reduces it by ₹100; the order total updates accordingly.

acceptance_criteria.title: Valid fixed code above minimum.
acceptance_criteria.text: Applying FLAT200 to a ₹1500 subtotal reduces it by ₹200.

acceptance_criteria.title: Fixed code below minimum.
acceptance_criteria.text: Applying FLAT200 to an ₹800 subtotal is rejected with "This code requires a minimum order of ₹1000."

acceptance_criteria.title: Expired code.
acceptance_criteria.text: Applying an expired code shows "This code has expired." and the total is unchanged.

acceptance_criteria.title: Invalid code.
acceptance_criteria.text: Applying a non-existent code shows "Invalid promo code." and the total is unchanged.

acceptance_criteria.title: Already used.
acceptance_criteria.text: Reapplying a single-use code already redeemed by the customer shows "This code has already been used."

acceptance_criteria.title: Discount cap.
acceptance_criteria.text: Applying FLAT200 to a ₹150 subtotal results in a subtotal of ₹0, never negative.

acceptance_criteria.title: Replace existing code.
acceptance_criteria.text: Applying a second code prompts the user to replace the first; on confirm, only the new discount applies.

acceptance_criteria.title: Empty input.
acceptance_criteria.text: Clicking Apply with no code shows "Enter a promo code."

acceptance_criteria.title: Whitespace/format.
acceptance_criteria.text: Leading/trailing spaces are trimmed before validation.

acceptance_criteria.title: Recalculation on cart change.
acceptance_criteria.text: If the cart changes after a code is applied and the subtotal drops below the minimum, the discount is re-validated and removed if no longer eligible.
